findings.finding: Data timeout and position-estimate validity need explicit handling; holding a position command still depends on estimate quality.
findings.relevance: The predictor-only two-second outage cases fail landing mission gates
findings.direction_alignment: Improve physics-based controller testing and provide an inspectable working demo
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Pausing descent may reduce touchdown motion but can increase scheduled tracking error and delay landing; predicted altitude can be wrong
findings.engineering_cost: Opt-in command guard, strict reconstruction, 24 fresh measured flights and separate regression/unseen demo cohorts
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-020 measures capture-aware landing commands with unchanged predictor and scoring
findings.verification_needed: Freeze parameters, preserve inactive traces, verify full-rate physics evidence, test unseen seeds without tuning, retain all failed gates

overall_recommendation: Evaluate a bounded descent guard in simulation with unchanged targets, limits and deadlines; keep it opt-in.
evidence_gaps: PX4 documentation does not validate this experimental guard
Small synthetic seed sets do not prove robust stability
Ideal attitude and supervisor remain; independent yaw refinement is unresolved
